parsed.note_claim: Ceuta was acquired by Portugal (in 1415) and ceded/passed to Spain, long before Morocco's independence in 1956, so it is not Moroccan territory.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: In 1415, Marinid Ceuta was conquered and annexed by the Kingdom of Portugal . In 1580, it was annexed by the Hispanic Monarchy , and the city chose to remain under Spanish authority after 1640.
parsed.reason: The page substantiates that Portugal took Ceuta in 1415 and that it came under Spanish authority well before 1956, though it does not mention the 1668 cession date or Morocco's independence.
